publicPage.intro: What anybody with your link sees: your picture, your number, and whether they can book.
publicPage.noBranch: Pick a branch to edit its public page.

cover.title: Cover photo
cover.help: The picture on your card in the app and at the top of your public page. Cropped to the same 4:3 frame as a dish.

phone.label: Phone
phone.help: Published on the page. International format, like +374 11 22 33 44. Leave empty to publish no number.

bookings.label: Take bookings from the public page
bookings.help: Off until you switch it on. While it is off the page still shows the room, the menu and the hours, and simply offers no booking.

publicPage.failed: That did not save. Nothing changed — try again.

listing.title: In the Yalla app
listing.intro: What diners read on your card and your page in the app. It has its own save button, apart from the settings above.

cuisine.label: Cuisine
cuisine.help: One line, like “Armenian & Mediterranean”. Up to 120 characters.

about.label: About
about.help: A short paragraph about the place. Up to 2000 characters.

website.label: Website
website.help: The full address, starting with https://. Leave empty to show none.

location.title: Map pin
location.help: Where the app puts you on the map and measures distance from. Decimal degrees, like 40.1843 and 44.5129.
location.bothOrNeither: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty to keep the current pin.
location.notANumber: Enter each coordinate as a decimal number, like 40.1843.
location.outOfRange: Latitude must be between -90 and 90, and longitude between -180 and 180. Check they are not swapped.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.help: Photos shown after the cover, in this order. Up to {{max}}.
gallery.full: The gallery is full. Remove a photo to add another.

listing.failed: The listing did not save. Nothing changed — try again.
listing.photoMissing: One of the gallery photos was not uploaded for this branch. Remove it and upload it again.

address.label: Street address
address.help: Shown to diners with the map pin. Change them together.
address.required: Enter the address together with the map pin.

district.label: District / neighbourhood
district.help: The area diners know you by, like “Kentron”. The app shows it under your name. Up to {{max}} characters.

listing.relocateOwnerOnly: Only an owner can move the map pin or change the address.

priceLevel.range: Pick a price level from {{min}} to {{max}}.

websiteUrl.scheme: The website must start with http:// or https://.
websiteUrl.tooLong: The website address can be at most {{max}} characters.

cuisine.tooLong: The cuisine can be at most {{max}} characters.

about.tooLong: The description can be at most {{max}} characters.

galleryPhotoIds.tooMany: The gallery can hold at most {{max}} photos.
galleryPhotoIds.duplicate: The same photo is in the gallery twice.

amenities.unknown: One of the amenities is not recognised. Reload the page and try again.

coordinates.pair: Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither.

photoXY.pair: A table pin is missing one of its two coordinates. Place the table again.
photoXY.range: A table pin is outside the photo. Place the table again.

address.tooLong: The address can be at most {{max}} characters.

district.tooLong: The district can be at most {{max}} characters.

errors.generic: Something in the form was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.

toast.nowPaid: {{name}} is now on the Paid plan
toast.nowFree: {{name}} is now on the Free plan
toast.created: {{name}} was created · you can give the owner a sign-in from the venue page
toast.copyManual: Select the link and copy it with Ctrl+C

empty.title: No venue matches that search
empty.body: Try another name, or clear the filters.
empty.deletedBody: Deleted venues stay here, so they can be restored.
empty.first: No venues yet. Add the first one.

tierDialog.lead: The change takes effect at once, at every branch of the venue.
tierDialog.mixedLead: {{paid}} of {{total}} branches are paid. Choose one plan for all of them.
tierDialog.paid1: Guests will order from their phones, by the table QR or a booking code
tierDialog.paid2: Table tabs open; guests ask for the bill in the app and pay the waiter
tierDialog.paid3: Bookings and the public page keep working as before
tierDialog.free1: Guests will no longer order from their phones
tierDialog.free2: No table tabs will open, and nobody can ask for the bill from their phone
tierDialog.free3: Bookings, the menu and the public page stay
tierDialog.noReturn: It can't go back to Paid until its menu is finished:
tierDialog.noReturnVenue: These branches can't go back to Paid until their menu is finished:
tierDialog.notReady_one: {{count}} dish is not ready to show a guest
tierDialog.notReady_other: {{count}} dishes are not ready to show a guest
tierDialog.openTabs: Tabs are open: going free would hide those bills from the people who owe them
tierDialog.notReadyHint: The venue's team finishes the menu in their console: a name, a price and a photo for every dish. Then try again.
tierDialog.openTabsHint: Wait until the tabs are settled, then try again.
tierDialog.perBranchHint: You can change each branch's plan on its own on the venue page.
tierDialog.branchRefusedPaid: The {{name}} branch cannot go paid yet
tierDialog.branchRefusedFree: The {{name}} branch cannot go free yet
tierDialog.branchLead: The change takes effect at once, at this branch only.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: The venue is hidden everywhere. Its history is kept, but nobody can sign in to it. You can restore it from the Deleted filter.
deleteDialog.hintMismatch: The name does not match yet
deleteDialog.blockedBody: A venue cannot be deleted while people are eating there or have booked to come.
deleteDialog.blockedHint: Close the tabs and wait for the bookings, or suspend the venue instead: that hides it at once and keeps everything.

add.title: New venue
add.lead: A venue and its first branch are created together: without a branch a venue has no rooms, no menu and no tables.
add.name: Venue's name
add.pinHelp: The map point guests are sent to. In Google Maps, right-click the place and copy the two numbers.
add.ownerLead: Optional. If you give an email, you will see a sign-in link to send the owner once the venue is created. You can also do it later, from the venue page's Staff tab.
add.summaryTierValue: Free · you can change it later

error.name: Give the venue a name
error.slugShape: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens only
error.branchSlugRequired: Give the branch a web address. A name written only in Armenian or Russian does not make one by itself.
error.pinRequired: Set the map pin: both the latitude and the longitude
error.pinNumber: Write them as numbers, for example 40.1843
error.pinRange: That is not a real place. Latitude is −90…90, longitude −180…180
error.ownerEmail: Write the email: the sign-in link is for it
error.email: That is not an email address, for example owner@lumen.am
error.generic: We could not create it. Nothing was saved.

add.ownerFailed: The venue was created, but the owner could not be added: {{reason}} Add them from the venue page's Staff tab.
add.linkFailed: The owner was added, with the PIN above. Their sign-in link was not made: {{reason}}

once.title: {{name}} was created
once.body: Shown now and never again. If it is lost, make a new one from the venue page: the old one stops working.
once.help: Send it in a chat. It works until {{when}}. The owner opens it and chooses a password.
once.pinHelp: For signing in on a tablet. This too is shown only now.
once.nag: Copy the link first: once this closes you will not see it again. Press Done again to close anyway.

venue.notFound: That venue could not be found.

blocked.unknown: Something at this venue is still in use. The server did not say what.

venue.failed: That did not go through. Nothing changed — try again.

state.offline: You are offline. Check the connection and try again.
state.notAvailable: This is not available from the backend yet.
state.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Sign in with your email and password
signIn.failed: The email or password is wrong. Check them and try again.
signIn.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue where you were.
signIn.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes, or reset your password.
signIn.lockedFor_one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute, or reset your password.
signIn.lockedFor_other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes, or reset your password.
signIn.emailInvalid: That email does not look right, for example name@yalla.am
signIn.noAccount: No account? Staff get their sign-in from the venue's owner or manager, and owners get theirs from Yalla.
signIn.claim: A console for restaurants and their teams
signIn.claimSub: Venues, staff and bookings in one place

forgotPage.title: Reset your password
forgotPage.body: We will send a link that works for 1 hour
forgotPage.sent: If there is an account at this address, the link is on its way. Check your inbox.
forgotPage.tooMany: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.

resetPassword.title: Choose a password
resetPassword.body: You will sign in to the console with this password. Nobody else, not even the person who invited you, will see it.
resetPassword.doneBody: Sign in with your email and the password you just chose.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
resetPassword.invalidBody: It has either been used already or has expired. Ask the person who sent it for a new one, or request one from the sign-in page.
resetPassword.signedInBody: This link is for someone else. Opening it here would use it up. Send it on.
resetPassword.claimSub: Choose a password and the console is ready
resetPassword.invalidSignIn: I have a password, sign in

rooms.noBranch: This account has no branch to set up rooms for.
rooms.intro: A guest picks a room, swipes through its photos and taps a table to book it. Click the spot on the photo where a table stands.

result.deactivated: Taken out of service because they have history: {{labels}}.
result.unpinnedByRemoval: Tables {{labels}} were on a photo no room keeps any more, so they are off it now.
result.unpinnedByMove: Tables {{labels}} were on a photo that moved to another room, so they are off it now.

conflict.title: Someone else changed the rooms.
conflict.body: A newer version was saved while you were editing, so your changes were not saved.
conflict.reloadFailed: The newer version could not be loaded. Your changes are still here; try again.

list.title: Rooms
list.empty: No rooms yet. Add the first one: the hall, the terrace, the VIP room.
list.duplicate: A room with that name exists already

room.name: Room name
room.duplicateName: Another room already has this name.
room.removeTables_one: Its table stays, with no room and no pin, until you place it again.
room.removeTables_other: Its {{count}} tables stay, with no room and no pin, until you place them again.

photos.empty: No photos of this room yet. Add one to start placing tables.
photos.removeBody_one: Table {{labels}} is pinned on it. It comes off the photo and waits under “Not on a photo” until you place it again.
photos.removeBody_other: Tables {{labels}} are pinned on it. They come off the photo and wait under “Not on a photo” until you place them again.
photos.addBody: Guests see it in a 4:3 frame. Choose which part of the photo to show.

stage.title: {{name}} · photo {{position}}
stage.label: Photo {{position}} of {{name}}. Click where a table stands to add it.
stage.hint: Click the photo to add a table. Move a pin by dragging it, or select it and use the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps).
stage.placing: Click where table {{label}} stands to place it. Esc to stop.
stage.addInMiddle: Add a table in the middle

table.none: Select a pin to edit its table, or click the photo to add a new one.
table.title: Table {{label}}
table.duplicateLabel: Another table already uses this number
table.noLabel: Every table needs the number printed on it

unpinned.title: Not on a photo
unpinned.none: Every table is on a photo.

inactive.title: Out of service
inactive.restored: Table {{label}} goes back into service when you save the rooms
inactive.cap: Kept for their history; they take no bookings

delete.title: Delete table {{label}}?
delete.removeBody: It has never been used, so it is removed for good.
delete.deactivateBody: It has bookings and tabs in its history, so it is kept for the records and taken out of service instead: it leaves the rooms and takes no more bookings.
delete.deactivated: Table {{label}} has history, so it was taken out of service
delete.seated: Guests are seated at the table now. Free the table first, then delete it.
delete.undone: Table {{label}} comes back when you save the rooms

warning.unpinned_one: Table {{labels}} can be booked but is on no photo, so guests can neither see nor book it.
warning.unpinned_other: Tables {{labels}} can be booked but are on no photo, so guests can neither see nor book them.
warning.duplicates: These numbers repeat: {{labels}}. Fix them before saving.
warning.duplicateRooms: More than one room is called {{names}}. Give each room its own name.

error.invalid: These rooms could not be saved.
error.photoInTwoRooms: A photo of {{name}} is also in another room, or twice in this one.
error.pinOtherRoom: Table {{label}} is pinned on another room's photo.
error.pinInvalid: Table {{label}}'s pin is incomplete or off the photo.
error.photoNotFound: A photo in these rooms was not uploaded for this branch. Remove it and add it again.

qr.title: QR code
qr.pending: The table gets its code when you save the rooms.
qr.regenerateWarning: The code stuck to table {{label}} stops working the moment this lands. Somebody has to go and replace the sticker.
qr.regenerated: Table {{label}} has a new QR code. Print it and replace the old sticker
qr.copyFailed: Could not copy: the code is selected, copy it by hand

saveBar.label: Saving
saveBar.duplicates: Some numbers repeat: fix them, then save

menu.noBranch: Your account is not attached to a branch.

category.title: Categories
category.emptyHint: Start with a category — “Coffee”, say, or “Hot dishes”.
category.inUse: One of this category's dishes is already on an order, so nothing was deleted. Mark those dishes sold out instead.
category.cap: Guests see them in this order
category.saveFailed: Could not save the category. Try again.
category.deleteBody_one: Its {{count}} dish goes with it and is not moved to another category. If it has been ordered already, nothing is deleted: mark it sold out instead.
category.deleteBody_other: Its {{count}} dishes go with it and are not moved to another category. If any of them has been ordered already, nothing is deleted: mark them sold out instead.

item.title: Dishes
item.empty: No dishes in this category yet

field.name: Name
field.priceHint: Whole dram. A new price does not change what was ordered already.
field.prepHint: Guests see it as an estimate when they order

incomplete.noneHere: Everything in this category is filled in
incomplete.title_one: {{count}} dish is not ready to show guests yet.
incomplete.title_other: {{count}} dishes are not ready to show guests yet.
incomplete.body: They are hidden from guests, and ordering from the phone cannot be switched on until you fill them in.

photo.dropHere: Drop a photo here, or click to choose one
photo.accepted: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB. Guests see it in the card's 4:3 frame.
photo.tooLarge: That photo is larger than 8 MB. Export it smaller and try again.
photo.badDimensions: Those dimensions will not work as a card.
photo.wrongFormat: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
photo.wrongFormatDetected: The file name says one thing and the bytes say another: this is really a {{format}}. Export it as a JPEG and try again.
photo.unreadable: This file could not be opened as a picture. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.

bulk.title: Photos in bulk
bulk.body: File names are matched against dishes. Nothing is attached until you confirm.
bulk.noneMatched: Nothing matched by name. Place them by hand below.

menu.orderFailed: Could not save the order. Try again.
menu.undoFailed: Could not undo that. Check the menu and add it back by hand.

empty.incompleteBody: Pick another category, or show everything.
empty.categoryBody: Add the first dish with the button above.
empty.noCategoryBody: Start with a category, with the button on the left.

dish.soldOutNow: “{{name}}” marked sold out: guests cannot order it
dish.availabilityFailed: Could not change that. Try again.
dish.todoTitle_one: Fill in {{count}} field so guests can see the dish:
dish.todoTitle_other: Fill in {{count}} fields so guests can see the dish:
dish.todoBody: These are the questions a guest would otherwise ask a waiter. Without them the dish is not shown.
dish.priceInvalid: The price must be a whole number above 0
dish.ingredientsHelp: Enter or a comma to add
dish.savedShown: “{{name}}” saved, and guests can see it
dish.savedHidden_one: “{{name}}” saved, but hidden from guests until you fill in {{count}} field
dish.savedHidden_other: “{{name}}” saved, but hidden from guests until you fill in {{count}} fields
dish.saveFailed: Could not save the dish. Try again.
dish.deleteBody: If the dish has been ordered already, it is not deleted: mark it sold out instead.
dish.deactivatedInstead: “{{name}}” has been ordered, so it was kept and marked sold out instead
dish.deleteFailed: Could not delete the dish. Try again.

hours.saveFailed: Could not save the opening hours.
hours.overlapWarning: Two spans on the same day overlap. Fix the marked rows before saving.
hours.sub: {{branch}} · The whole week is saved at once. A closing time before the opening time means the next day.
hours.removeSpan: Remove the span after the break
hours.summaryTitle: How the page will show it
hours.overlapBar: Some hours overlap: fix them, then save

special.title: Special days
special.cap: Holidays, time off, a day's closure. They win over the week's hours.
special.empty: No special days. The 1st of January is usually the first.
special.name: Name
special.taken: That day is on the list already
special.tooFar: That day is more than a year ahead
special.noteTooLong: The name can be at most {{max}} characters
special.badHours: The opening and closing times are the same
special.failed: Could not save the special days. Try again.
special.affected_one: {{count}} booking on those days no longer fits the hours. It was not changed: call the guest.
special.affected_other: {{count}} bookings on those days no longer fit the hours. They were not changed: call the guests.
special.superseded: Someone else changed the special days. The newer list is loaded; try again.

policy.serviceChargeNote: The service charge appears on every diner's bill as its own line, from the first item. It is snapshotted onto a tab when the tab opens, so changing it does not affect tabs already open.

booking.title: How far ahead people can book
booking.body: How far the calendar opens, and how late a booking can still be made.

holding.title: How long a table is held
holding.body: These decide how many bookings fit on one table in an evening.

lateness.title: When somebody is late
lateness.body: Nothing is cancelled automatically. These decide when staff are prompted.

approval.title: What needs a person
approval.body: A booking is either confirmed straight away or it waits for you.

money.title: What goes on the bill
money.body: Both of these are visible to every diner.

turnTimeMinutes.label: How long a table is held
turnTimeMinutes.why: How long a table is kept for a booking. It is why a diner is told “available 18:00 – 19:45”.

bufferMinutes.label: Turnaround between bookings
bufferMinutes.why: Extra time between two bookings for clearing the table. Not shown to the diner.

walkInHoldbackMinutes.label: Walk-in warning window
walkInHoldbackMinutes.why: How close to a booking a walk-in may still be seated before staff are warned.

maxSeatOverhang.label: People over the seat count
maxSeatOverhang.why: How many more than a table seats may be sat at it. Five at a four-top is normal.

graceMinutes.label: How long a late party keeps the table
graceMinutes.why: How long past the booked time the table is still theirs before it may be released.

lateNudgeAfterMinutes.label: When to ask if they are coming
lateNudgeAfterMinutes.why: How long past the start before the diner is asked to confirm they are on their way.

graceExtensionMinutes.label: What “we're on our way” buys
graceExtensionMinutes.why: How much longer one tap from the diner keeps the table.

minLeadMinutes.label: Shortest notice
minLeadMinutes.why: How close to a slot a booking may still be made. Thirty minutes means a 19:00 table cannot be booked at 18:45.

bookingWindowDays.label: How far ahead the calendar goes
bookingWindowDays.why: How far into the future a diner can book.

cancellationDeadlineMinutes.label: Free cancellation deadline
cancellationDeadlineMinutes.why: How long before the booking a diner may cancel without it going on their record.

autoConfirm.label: Confirm bookings automatically
autoConfirm.why: Off sends every booking to you to approve.

approvalRequiredAbovePartySize.label: Party size that needs approval
approvalRequiredAbovePartySize.why: Parties above this wait for you even when automatic confirmation is on.

serviceChargePercent.label: Service charge
serviceChargePercent.why: Added to every bill as its own line, from the first item.

pricesIncludeVat.label: Prices include VAT
pricesIncludeVat.why: Affects how the bill is presented, nothing else.

affected.label: Existing bookings
affected.body_one: {{count}} existing booking no longer fits the new rules.
affected.body_other: {{count}} existing bookings no longer fit the new rules.
affected.explain: They were not changed and not cancelled — a settings edit never rewrites a booking. The new rules apply to future bookings only.

checklist.title: What is still needed before guests can come
checklist.body: The branch takes guests once all of this is done. The order does not matter.

step.floorPlan: Rooms set up, with a table diners can book on a photo

reports.intro: How the week went, and what is worth changing.
reports.rangeTooLong: A report covers at most {{max}} days. Narrow the range.
reports.partialRange: Nothing was recorded before {{date}} in this range.

range.backwards: The end date is before the start date.

export.failed: That file could not be downloaded. Try again.

empty.title: No data in this range
empty.body: Try a wider range. This does not mean the venue took nothing — there is simply nothing recorded on these days.

occupancy.title: Occupancy
occupancy.blurb: When the room fills, and how long people actually stay.

turnTime.title: Actual turn time against policy
turnTime.blurb: A distribution, not an average. A fast lunch and a slow dinner average to a number that describes neither.
turnTime.noSittings: No sittings closed in this range.
turnTime.overPolicy: The middle sitting runs {{median}} minutes against a policy of {{policy}} — {{overBy}} minutes longer. {{percent}}% of sittings run past the policy, so the system is refusing bookings the table could actually have taken.
turnTime.withinPolicy: The middle sitting runs {{median}} minutes, inside the {{policy}}-minute policy. {{percent}}% of sittings run past it.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.blurb: How many were booked, and what became of them.

noApp.title: Web bookings without an app
noApp.blurb: These guests cannot be reminded. No app means no push channel, so the reminder, the late nudge and one-tap cancel never reach them. This is the number that decides whether SMS is worth paying for.
noApp.label: No way to reach them

leadTime.title: How far ahead people book
leadTime.reading: This is the distribution the booking window should be set from.

menu.title: Menu
menu.blurb: What sold, what did not, and what got sent back.
menu.noneSold: Nothing was ordered in this range.

neverOrdered.blurb: A dish nobody orders is inventory, prep time and menu space. Tap a name to open it in the editor.
neverOrdered.none: Everything on the menu sold in this range.

voids.title: Voided lines
voids.blurb: A dish voided often is either mis-described on the menu or badly made.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.blurb: What was taken, by day and by hour.

adjustments.title: Comps and discounts
adjustments.none: Nothing was comped or discounted in this range.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: They stop appearing on the tablets and can no longer sign in. Nothing is deleted: when they are back, reactivate them from “Show deactivated”.

staff.intro: Who works here, and which devices they sign in on.
staff.noVenue: This account is not attached to a venue.

empty.title: Nobody here yet
empty.body: Without staff, nobody can sign in to the counter screen.

field.name: Full name
field.branchVenueWide: A general manager works at every branch of the venue.
field.emailHelp: They open a link and choose their own password. Nobody types one for them.
field.emailLater: Leave it empty to issue the sign-in later, from their row.

ownPin.title: Change my PIN
ownPin.help: Type a new 4-digit PIN for the tablets, twice. It is not shown anywhere.
ownPin.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
ownPin.changedBody: Use it the next time you sign in on a tablet.

pin.help: Personal. There are no shared PINs — a shared one makes "who gave away my table" unanswerable.
pin.shownOnceBody: Shown now and never again. After this it can only be replaced, not looked up.
pin.neverShared: Everyone has their own. Do not write it on the till.

signIn.emailRequired: Enter the address they will sign in with.
signIn.emailTooLong: An email address is at most 320 characters.
signIn.addressChanges: From the moment you send this they sign in with {{email}} instead of {{old}}; their password stays the same.
signIn.tooManyRequests: Too many links issued in the last minute. Wait a moment, then try again.
signIn.linkBody: Paste it to them in a chat. They open it and choose their own password — nobody types one for them.
signIn.onceOnly: Shown now and never again. If it is lost, send a new one — the old one stops working.
signIn.keepsPassword: Their current password keeps working until they open this.
signIn.copyFirst: Copy the link first, or press Done.
signIn.notIssued: Added, but without a sign-in link:

roleInfo.owner: Runs the venue: every branch, the staff and the settings.
roleInfo.generalManager: Runs the floor plans, menus and staff of every branch.
roleInfo.manager: Runs the floor plan, menu and staff for their branch.
roleInfo.waiter: Takes orders and seats tables on the counter tablet, with a PIN.
roleInfo.kitchen: Sees and updates orders on the kitchen screen, with a PIN.

wizard.roleHelp: This decides what they can see and do.
wizard.coOwnerNote: A co-owner is added with a PIN. Their console sign-in is issued by the Yalla team.
wizard.pinShownAgain: You'll see it once more after adding, to read out to them.
wizard.signInAfter: After you press Add, the link appears once, for you to paste to them.

staffId.label: Staff ID
staffId.help: Needed only to sign in on a tablet that cannot load the staff list. Copy it and send it to them.

devices.title: Tablets
devices.blurb: The tablets the counter screen runs on.
devices.empty: No devices enrolled at this branch.
devices.grantsNothing: A device grants nothing on its own — every action still needs a PIN on top. A stolen tablet is not a stolen till.

code.instructions: Type this code on the tablet to enrol it.
code.onceOnly: One use only. Lose it and generate another — the old one cannot be looked up.

confirm.title: Revoke {{name}}?
confirm.body: {{name}} stops working immediately. If that is the tablet in service, the counter screen goes offline.
confirm.permanent: Permanent. A device that turns up again is enrolled afresh.

approvals.title: Waiting for your decision
approvals.body: Nothing is promised to the guest until you answer. Short-notice bookings have 15 minutes for an answer.
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting. New requests will appear here.
approvals.timeUp: Time is up. The diner is being told the venue could not confirm.
approvals.reasonHint: Recorded on the booking. The diner is told it was declined, not why.
approvals.failed: Could not record the decision. Try again.
approvals.tooLate: Too late: the time to answer ran out, and the diner has been told the venue could not confirm.
approvals.offline: You are offline. The decision was not sent.
approvals.awaitingEarlierGuest: The guest before is answering this in the app. It is decided when they do, or declined if they do not.
approvals.approved: {{name}}'s booking is confirmed · the guest will be notified

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.reasonRequired: Give a reason for hiding this review.
reviews.platformHidden: Hidden by the Yalla team. Only they can show it again.
reviews.failed: That did not go through. Nothing changed — try again.

unsavedChanges.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving them?
unsavedChanges.switchBody: {{branch}} has unsaved changes. If you switch, they will be lost.

notFound.title: This venue was not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the venue was deleted. Deleted venues stay on the Venues page under the “Deleted” filter.
notFound.pageBody: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved. Start again from the Venues list or Home.
